reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis relies on an organic melamine layer surviving and functioning beneficially under harsh, high-temperature, oxidizing automotive exhaust conditions, which contradicts the well-known thermal and oxidative instability of such organic molecules.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear, well-defined, and includes a decisive falsification criterion based on measurable performance and post-mortem analysis.
reasons.usefulness: Despite being physically implausible, the hypothesis is highly useful as a provocative idea that forces a researcher to confront the critical stability boundary between electrocatalysis and heterogeneous exhaust catalysis.
